disorder-name.detail: DSM-5 obsessive-compulsive disorder; first-episode and untreated patients; clinical cohort to which normative model of FCS was applied
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Atotal of ninety-eight first-episode and untreated patients diagnosed with OCD were recruited from outpatient services within the Department of Psychiatry at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University. Diagnosis was established independently by two experienced psychiatrists in accordance with the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition (DSM-5) criteria for OCD."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Single-site study; data collected at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, China. No publicly named dataset.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Atotal of ninety-eight first-episode and untreated patients diagnosed with OCD were recruited from outpatient services within the Department of Psychiatry at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University."

age.detail: Age statistics for OCD clinical cohort (N=99) as reported in Table 1. Min and max not reported.

sex.detail: Male N=52 (53.06%) directly reported. Female N estimated as 99 - 52 = 47; female % = 47/99 = 47.5% (rounded to 46.9% per paper's 53.06% for male, leaving 46.94% for female). Total N=99 (Table 1). Note: Methods section states 98 patients recruited but Table 1 and abstract report N=99; N=99 used per Table 1.
